Downstream analyses, such as clustering, trajectory analysis, and visualization, can use213 the integrated Harmony adjusted coordinates instead of the commonly used PCA coordinates. As a corollary, Harmony214 does not alter the expression values of individual genes to account for dataset-speciﬁc differences.
